title: campanula balcanica f. borbasina
intro: Campanula balcanica f. borbasina, commonly known as Balkan bellflower, is a flowering plant species in the family Campanulaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects that provide health benefits such as reducing pain, inflammation, and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Campanula balcanica f. borbasina include antiseptic, antispasmodic, and diuretic properties, which can aid in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
